text: Gardening is about more than just planting seeds and nurturing them. It's also about caring for the soil and adding nourishment to the plants. One way to do this is by using mulch, which helps retain moisture and suppress weeds. Another important step is composting, which adds nutrients back into the soil and promotes healthy plant growth. Remember, gardening is a balance of care and attention to detail, and by adding mulch and compost, you can create a thriving garden that will bring beauty and life to your space.
